headline: Anthropic Market Debut Fails to Revive Tech Optimism as Wall Street Corrects
summary: Anthropic's stock market debut failed to reverse market pessimism, as corrections in the Nasdaq and S&P 500 re-ignited fears regarding technology investment and inflation.
why: Initial public offerings of prominent artificial intelligence startups serve as market sentiment indicators for venture-backed technology valuations.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Lackluster tech IPO reception reinforces broader index corrections.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weak investor reception for high-profile AI offerings compounded existing macro inflation fears and triggered index-wide sell-offs.
